rules.description: Omarchy: SUPER + LEFT - Focus left window
Omarchy: SUPER + RIGHT - Focus right window
Omarchy: SUPER + UP - Focus window above
Omarchy: SUPER + DOWN - Focus window below
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + LEFT - Swap window left
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + RIGHT - Swap window right
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + UP - Swap window up
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + DOWN - Swap window down
Omarchy: SUPER + W - Close window
Omarchy: SUPER + T - Toggle floating
Omarchy: SUPER + F - Full screen
Omarchy: SUPER + ALT + F - Full width
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + F - Center column
Omarchy: SUPER + L - Toggle workspace layout
Omarchy: SUPER + S - Toggle scratchpad
Omarchy: SUPER + ALT + S - Move window to scratchpad
Omarchy: SUPER + MINUS - Narrower
Omarchy: SUPER + EQUAL - Wider
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + MINUS - Shorter
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + EQUAL - Taller
Omarchy: SUPER + ALT + MINUS - Narrower a little
Omarchy: SUPER + ALT + EQUAL - Wider a little
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + MINUS - Narrower a lot
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + EQUAL - Wider a lot
Omarchy: SUPER + 1 - Workspace 1
Omarchy: SUPER + 2 - Workspace 2
Omarchy: SUPER + 3 - Workspace 3
Omarchy: SUPER + 4 - Workspace 4
Omarchy: SUPER + 5 - Workspace 5
Omarchy: SUPER + 6 - Workspace 6
Omarchy: SUPER + 7 - Workspace 7
Omarchy: SUPER + 8 - Workspace 8
Omarchy: SUPER + 9 - Workspace 9
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 1 - Move window to workspace 1
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 2 - Move window to workspace 2
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 3 - Move window to workspace 3
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 4 - Move window to workspace 4
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 5 - Move window to workspace 5
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 6 - Move window to workspace 6
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 7 - Move window to workspace 7
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 8 - Move window to workspace 8
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + 9 - Move window to workspace 9
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 1 - Move window silently to workspace 1
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 2 - Move window silently to workspace 2
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 3 - Move window silently to workspace 3
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 4 - Move window silently to workspace 4
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 5 - Move window silently to workspace 5
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 6 - Move window silently to workspace 6
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 7 - Move window silently to workspace 7
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 8 - Move window silently to workspace 8
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + 9 - Move window silently to workspace 9
Omarchy: SUPER + TAB - Next workspace
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + TAB - Previous workspace
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + TAB - Former workspace
Omarchy: ALT + TAB - Next window
Omarchy: ALT + SHIFT + TAB - Previous window
Omarchy: CTRL + ALT + TAB - Next monitor
Omarchy: CTRL + ALT + SHIFT + TAB - Previous monitor
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + LEFT - Workspace to left monitor
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + RIGHT - Workspace to right monitor
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + UP - Workspace to monitor above
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + DOWN - Workspace to monitor below
Omarchy: SUPER + RETURN - Terminal
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + RETURN - Browser
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + B - Browser
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + B - Browser (private)
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + F - File manager
Omarchy: SUPER + SHIFT + N - Editor
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + T - Activity
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + C - Capture menu
Omarchy: SUPER + CTRL + L - Lock
Omarchy: SUPER + K - Keybindings
Linux text editing: Ctrl+arrows/Backspace, Home/End
Linux key positions: [fn][control][option][command] -> Ctrl Fn Super Alt
PC keyboard: Ctrl is the app-shortcut key outside terminals
